question: According to census 2011, the literacy rate of India is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**74.04 percent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the 2011 census, the literacy rate in India is 74%.
 
• To be more precise the literacy rate was 74.04%.
 
• The literacy rate of the male population and the female population was 82.14 % and 65.46% respectively.
 
• The literacy rate in the 2001 census was 64.8%.&l
